purpose: Accelerate the successful larger-basis coherent state without dropping orbitals or determinants
changes: Exact occupied-subspace coordinates and small Cholesky normalization replace full-basis matrix exponentials
One full Cholesky fast path replaces repeated determinant-by-determinant independence solves; retain the original fallback
initial_state: Convert the same original Coulomb-response orbital seed, keeping its physical determinant span
optimization: Same 400 Adam steps, 0.02 initial learning rate and 0.0002 final rate; same variational objective, no energy labels
assessment: Check same saved physical spans before training; report matched state errors, all failures and wall time against the saved rotation/serial-coefficient runs. No seed/mode/iteration sweep.
acceptance: Physical scalar/norm retained, reference not degraded, each same-basis error below 1 kcal/mol; report any accuracy change rather than hiding it
timing_scope: GPU numerical optimization wall time with one-core host, separately from preparation/startup
